name: @dsh-external/dsh-product-subagents
description: DSH subagent providers for the local claude-code / codex CLIs: registers the host-plane 'claude-code' and 'codex' providers the nine security presets' tool rows name. The CLIs keep their own model backend config (~/.claude/settings.json env, ~/.codex/config.toml); this plugin only spawns them headless and maps exit to a subagent run.
author: SeaOf0
